title: The Ancient Mammal That Changes Our Understanding of Dinosaur Origins - Nautilus
gist: A Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology study re-examines 1963 Manda fossil bed specimens from Tanzania, shifting understanding of dinosaur origins and suggesting Nyasasaurus may not have been the first dinosaur.

insights.claim: The best evidence-based hypothesis held that the earliest known dinosaurs lived in Tanzania 240 million years ago, but a new Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology study shifts that understanding.
